summary: Tested Fast Track conditional logic and interface optimization. Fixed 3 backend bugs: 1) Added ft_equipment_items field to QuoteCreateWithPDF and Quote models, 2) Fixed quote creation to store ft_equipment_items, 3) Fixed deliver endpoint to generate Nota de Entrega PDF for Fast Track with equipment (moved PDF generation outside warehouse block). All 8 backend tests pass. Frontend code review confirms conditional logic is correctly implemented.
